svg.desc: A GPU job's life Completion, time limits and crashes take distinct paths through the deployment adapter. Dispatch and outcomes Idle watch Before paying for a rental save + requeue retry after 3 retries A ready job waits. GPU preference; flexible placement. Retain the exact job identity. Completed work advances. Official + independent evaluation. Verify file checksums. Save items; requeue; zero failures. Keep the failure receipt. A bounded recovery path. Retain all attempt records. Accept or return the result. Utilization below 10%. Executor investigates. Lead steps in. Memory allocation alone is a separate observation. Queue ready Dry run passed Scorer has own GPU Stop timer set Queue Dispatcher Running Done Score Return locally Time limit Crashed Retry up to 3 Failed Lead review 10-min average 30 minutes 60 minutes
